_comments.json: JSON cannot use // comments. This _comments object is ignored by importProblems.js. Copy constraints from here when filling problems.
_comments.problemCreatorEmail: Optional. Email of an existing user (usually an admin). If omitted, the first admin in the DB is used. Do not put problemCreator ObjectId here.
_comments.problems: Non-empty array. One DB problem is created per object. title must be unique.
_comments.title: Required unique string.
_comments.description: Required string. Problem statement shown to students.
_comments.difficulty: Required. Allowed values: easy | medium | hard
_comments.tags: Required. Allowed values: array | string | linkedList | stack | queue | hashing | tree | heap | graph | greedy | dp | recursion | backtracking | binarySearch | bitManipulation
_comments.videoUrl: Optional string. Empty string is allowed.
_comments.visibleTestCases: Required. Exactly 3 objects. Each needs input, output, and explanation.
_comments.invisibleTestCases: Required. Exactly 20 objects. Each needs input and output only (no explanation). Alias: hiddenTestCases.
_comments.startCode: Required. Exactly these 3 languages: nodejs, java, cpp17. Each needs language + initialCode (function stub only, no delimiter).
_comments.referenceSolution: Required. Same 3 languages: nodejs, java, cpp17. completeCode must be a full runnable program.
_comments.completeCode: Must contain // USER_SOLUTION_START and // USER_SOLUTION_END around the solution function. Must print __JUDGE_TC_END__ after every test-case answer. Do not put the delimiter in test-case output fields.
_comments.languages: nodejs | java | cpp17 (C++, Java, JavaScript aliases are also accepted)

problems.title: Count Even Numbers
problems.description: Given an integer n followed by n integers, print how many of them are even.
